name: landing-flight-titles
description: Tests flight title detection for non-standard formats. Couple A lands via 'TLV-NRT' (bare IATA-IATA, no arrow), couple B via 'טוקיו' (Hebrew city name, no separator). Both must be detected as Japan arrivals, with the day start and arrival info computed from the flight rather than falling back to 15:00. A: NRT to Yokohama = 99 min ride, start = 09:15 + max(80+99,120) = 734 min (12:14). B: 'טוקיו' maps to HND, 46 min ride, start = 681 min (11:21). Day 2 is a normal Yokohama day (09:30 start).
